state_machine.behavior: Debounce timer is reset and VFD_RUN is FALSE.
The debounce timer qualifies the continuous permissive; VFD_RUN follows its current-scan Q output.

timer_plan.name: ViscosityDebounce
timer_plan.behavior: Call once unconditionally per scan. Elapsed time is zero on the first permitted sample; Q becomes TRUE when continuous elapsed time reaches PT.
timer_plan.reset_conditions: IN is FALSE, including on either sampled E-stop activation or raw viscosity loss; clear elapsed time and Q in that scan.
timer_plan.implementation: Use a timer or equivalent monotonic-clock FB that supports the full specified TIME range and precision. Its current-scan Q must be available to output assignment.

priorities: Sampled E-stop activation or raw viscosity loss immediately clears run permission and debounce qualification in the same scan.
After either loss, require a complete new debounce interval before running.
Maintenance indication is informational and never inhibits the pump.
Software response is scan-bound; use an appropriate independent safety-rated circuit for the E-stop safety function.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.actions: Sample all inputs and the monotonic time once. Derive any required edges from the previous samples; do not assume prior input stability on the first scan.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.actions: Transition to BLOCKED if either permissive input is FALSE; otherwise transition to or remain in PERMITTED. This establishes the timer input for the current scan.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls
scan_execution_order.actions: Outside all CASE and IF blocks, call ViscosityDebounce exactly once with IN=(state=PERMITTED) and PT=DebounceTime. Use the current sampled time if required by the implementation.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.actions: Compute run_next as PASTE_E_STOP_NC AND VISCOSITY_OK AND ViscosityDebounce.Q. Compute acc_next from the pre-scan PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC, adding TIME_TO_LTIME(CycleTime) exactly once if run_next is TRUE and otherwise preserving it. Assign VFD_RUN=run_next, PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC=acc_next, and PUMP_MAINT_DUE=(acc_next >= LTIME#500h), each from one unified assignment path.

notes: DebounceTime and CycleTime are strictly positive; DebounceTime is constant within a test. Inputs are stable between timed samples.
Exact runtime accumulation requires the accumulated result to remain representable in LTIME; behavior beyond its maximum is outside the specified domain.
